HARM the rule prevents: a slide reader meets a referent no earlier slide named and cannot resolve it. Present: `wonder.md` is named nowhere else in the file and (grep -rln -F wonder.md curriculum) appears in no student-facing module, exercise or lecture, only in trainer-modules.md, so the arc-earned-spine carve-out does not reach it. (`challenge.md` is earned in exercises and passes the carve-out.) Closest other line: chunk 6 line 283 "the pushback rounds" resolves to audience-held practice, left as is.

Closest: chunk 8 "Index of agent shapes" also holds the ### "More dishes to cook" (line 409), whose lead (line 411 "composition prompts, not full recipes") states the shift, so the header is not contradicted. Chunk 7 "Data sources" lead says "Eighteen sources" (line 311) while 19 bold entries follow (grep -c "^\*\*" over lines 313-359 = 19): a count error in the lead, not a header contradiction; filed as a suggestion.

chunk 3 "Worked Dish 2": line 197: "No essay. No auto-reply. No customer-facing action. Just enough for the right human to open the thread fast." Matches the banned "Not X. Not Y. Z." construction (three anaphoric negations then the positive), and the chunk repeats the two-beat shape at line 201 "The fix was not \"be less alarmed.\"" and line 207 "The value was not only faster routing. It was better ambiguity capture." HARM: at slide scale the tic is the memorable line. Other sub-items checked: no self-grading superlative (closest line 269 "load-bearing piece", a design claim), no number-plus-retraction, no empty-leg verb triplet (line 211 legs are each concrete).
